theorem noncritical_aeval_mem {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) : aeval x p ∈ P.1 := by
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range]
  refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  exact mul_mem (P.algebraMap_mem _) (pow_mem hx _)

For every x ∈ O_P and every p ∈ ℚ[X], reducing the evaluated element p(x) gives the same result as evaluating p at res_P(x) in κ(P): res_P(p(x)) = p(res_P(x)). The membership proof for p(x) is the preceding helper. This concerns the full residue field, without choosing an embedding into ℚ̄. No curve-field, transcendence, nonzero, or degree assumption is present. The complete body uses compatibility of polynomial evaluation with ring homomorphisms and uniqueness of the rational ring homomorphism; it is not compilation-verified here.

theorem noncritical_residue_aeval {x : K} (hx : x ∈ P.1) (p : ℚ[X]) :
    P.residue ⟨aeval x p, P.noncritical_aeval_mem hx p⟩ =
      aeval (P.residue ⟨x, hx⟩) p := by
  have h1 : (⟨aeval x p, P.noncritical_aeval_mem hx p⟩ : P.1) =
      eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hx⟩ p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change aeval x p = P.1.subtype (eval₂ P.ratHom ⟨x, hx⟩ p)
    rw [hom_eval₂, aeval_def]
    congr 1
  rw [h1, hom_eval₂, aeval_def]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext_rat _ _

theorem noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero {y : K} (hy : y ∈ P.1) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (h : P.residue ⟨y, hy⟩ = 0) : 0 < P.ord y :=
  (P.ord_pos_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (a := ⟨y, hy⟩) hy0).mpr
    ((P.residue_eq_zero_iff).mp h)

theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalRamificationPositive
    {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (ψ : M.K) (hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ) (P : Place M.K) :
    0 < ramIdx M hDVR ψ P
declarations.en: Let N be a natural number and M : Model N. Thus M.K is an intermediate field of the algebraic closure of ℚ(t), with elements u and v such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N + v^N = 1, ℚ(u,v) = M.K, and M.K is finite of degree N over ℚ(u). Let hDVR assert that every place has a discrete valuation ring. A place P is a proper valuation subring O_P of M.K containing ℚ; no affine restriction is imposed. Write κ(P) for its full residue field and res_P : O_P → κ(P) for the actual residue map. The integer ord_P is the normalized discrete order, with the convention ord_P(0) = 0. For any f ∈ M.K, define the integer e_P(f) as ord_P(q(f)) when f ∈ O_P, where q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)), and as −ord_P(f) when f ∉ O_P. This is the actual definition of ramIdx M hDVR f P. For every ψ ∈ M.K transcendental over ℚ and every place P, the theorem states e_P(ψ) > 0. At a nonpole, finiteness of the full residue field follows from the model-derived curve-field structure, so its residue is integral over ℚ and its minimal polynomial q is nonzero. Transcendence of ψ implies q(ψ) ≠ 0. The evaluated element q(ψ) lies in O_P and has zero residue because q annihilates res_P(ψ). Its nonzero status is what allows zero residue to imply strictly positive order despite ord_P(0)=0. At a pole, ord_P(ψ)<0, hence −ord_P(ψ)>0. This complete proof body adds no assumption beyond the displayed type: in particular no separately supplied residue-finiteness, constant-field, derivative, or composition law. The source comments identify it as an adaptation of ramIdx_pos; this review establishes the body and dependency shape statically, not by compilation or an upstream comparison.
declarations.zh_Hans: 设 N 为自然数，M : Model N。也就是说，M.K 是 ℚ(t) 的代数闭包中的中间域，带有元素 u、v，满足 u 在 ℚ 上超越，u^N + v^N = 1，ℚ(u,v) = M.K，且 M.K 是 ℚ(u) 的 N 次有限扩张。设 hDVR 表示每个赋值点的赋值环都是离散赋值环。赋值点 P 是 M.K 中包含 ℚ 且不等于整个域的赋值子环 O_P；这里没有仿射开集限制。记 κ(P) 为它的完整剩余域，res_P : O_P → κ(P) 为实际剩余映射。整数 ord_P 是规范化离散阶，并约定 ord_P(0) = 0。对任意 f ∈ M.K，若 f ∈ O_P，令 q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f))，并定义整数 e_P(f) = ord_P(q(f))；若 f ∉ O_P，则定义 e_P(f) = −ord_P(f)。这正是 ramIdx M hDVR f P 的定义。对每个在 ℚ 上超越的 ψ ∈ M.K 和每个赋值点 P，定理断言 e_P(ψ) > 0。在非极点情形，模型导出的曲线函数域结构保证完整剩余域在 ℚ 上有限维，因此剩余类在 ℚ 上整，其最小多项式 q 非零。ψ 的超越性保证 q(ψ) ≠ 0。求值元素 q(ψ) 属于 O_P；由于 q 消去 res_P(ψ)，它的剩余类为零。正是 q(ψ) 的非零性，使剩余类为零能够推出严格正阶，而不受 ord_P(0)=0 这一约定影响。在极点情形，ord_P(ψ)<0，所以 −ord_P(ψ)>0。这个完整证明没有增加类型中所列假设之外的条件，尤其没有另行输入剩余域有限性、常数域条件、导数理论或复合规律。源码注释称其改编自 ramIdx_pos；本次仅静态确认了证明体及依赖结构，没有编译，也没有与上游逐项比较。
declarations.ja: N を自然数、M : Model N とする。M.K は ℚ(t) の代数閉包の中間体であり、元 u、v は、u が ℚ 上超越的、u^N + v^N = 1、ℚ(u,v) = M.K、かつ M.K が ℚ(u) 上 N 次の有限拡大という条件を満たす。hDVR は、すべての付値点の付値環が離散付値環であることを表す。付値点 P は、ℚ を含み M.K 全体とは異なる付値部分環 O_P であり、アフィン開集合への制限はない。κ(P) はその剰余体全体、res_P : O_P → κ(P) は実際の剰余写像である。整数 ord_P は正規化された離散位数であり、ord_P(0) = 0 と定める。f ∈ M.K に対し、f ∈ O_P ならば q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)) として整数 e_P(f) = ord_P(q(f))、f ∉ O_P ならば e_P(f) = −ord_P(f) と定める。これが ramIdx M hDVR f P の定義である。ℚ 上超越的なすべての ψ ∈ M.K とすべての付値点 P に対し、この定理は e_P(ψ) > 0 を述べる。極でない場合、モデルから得られる曲線関数体の構造により、剰余体全体は ℚ 上有限次元である。したがって ψ の剰余は ℚ 上整で、その最小多項式 q は非零である。ψ の超越性から q(ψ) ≠ 0 が従う。q(ψ) は O_P に属し、q が res_P(ψ) を零にするため、その剰余は零である。ord_P(0)=0 と定めているにもかかわらず、剰余が零であることから正の位数を導けるのは、q(ψ) が非零だからである。極の場合には ord_P(ψ)<0 であり、−ord_P(ψ)>0 が従う。完結した証明本体は、表示した型の仮定以外を追加していない。剰余体の有限性、定数体の条件、微分の理論、合成則を別の入力として要求していない。ソースのコメントでは ramIdx_pos の移植とされている。本審査は証明本体と依存関係の静的な確認であり、コンパイルや上流との照合は行っていない。

theorem noncriticalRamificationPositive {N : ℕ} (M : Model N)
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (ψ : M.K) (hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ)
    (P : Place M.K) : 0 < ramIdx M hDVR ψ P := by
  letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField
  unfold ramIdx
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [ord_eq_placeOrd]
    have hr := P.noncritical_isIntegral_residue ⟨ψ, h⟩
    have hm0 : aeval ψ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨ψ, h⟩)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h0 => hψ ⟨_, minpoly.ne_zero hr, h0⟩
    refine P.noncritical_ord_pos_of_residue_eq_zero (P.noncritical_aeval_mem h _) hm0 ?_
    rw [P.noncritical_residue_aeval h]
    exact minpoly.aeval ℚ _
  · rw [ord_eq_placeOrd]
    have := (P.ord_neg_iff).mpr h
    omega

theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification
    {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (ψ : M.K) (hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (h : NoncriticalP1.ElemMap) :
    Transcendental ℚ (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) ∧
    noncriticalValue M x (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) =
      h.apply (noncriticalValue M x ψ) ∧
    ramIdx M hDVR (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) x.P =
      ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P * (h.ramIdx (noncriticalValue M x ψ) : ℤ)
declarations.en: Let N be a natural number and M : Model N. Thus M.K is an intermediate field of the algebraic closure of ℚ(t), with elements u and v such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N + v^N = 1, ℚ(u,v) = M.K, and M.K is finite of degree N over ℚ(u). Let hDVR assert that every place has a discrete valuation ring. A place P is a proper valuation subring O_P of M.K containing ℚ; no affine restriction is imposed. Write κ(P) for its full residue field and res_P : O_P → κ(P) for the actual residue map. The integer ord_P is the normalized discrete order, with the convention ord_P(0) = 0. For any f ∈ M.K, define the integer e_P(f) as ord_P(q(f)) when f ∈ O_P, where q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)), and as −ord_P(f) when f ∉ O_P. This is the actual definition of ramIdx M hDVR f P. An algebraic point x consists of any such place P and any ring embedding σ : κ(P) → ℚ̄, where ℚ̄ is the fixed algebraic closure of ℚ. Its value z_x(f) is σ(res_P(f)) if f ∈ O_P, and ∞ otherwise. Thus all places, the full residue fields, and every residue-field embedding are retained. An elementary map h is either a rational Möbius map (az+b)/(cz+d), with a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ and ad−bc ≠ 0, or a polynomial p ∈ ℚ[X] of positive natural degree. Its field action h_K uses this rational expression or p(f). On ℙ¹(ℚ̄), a Möbius map sends a finite z with cz+d=0 to ∞ and otherwise to (az+b)/(cz+d); it sends ∞ to ∞ if c=0 and to a/c otherwise. A polynomial sends finite z to p(z) and ∞ to ∞. Its natural-number local index e_h(z) is 1 for a Möbius map, deg(p) for a polynomial at ∞, and the root multiplicity of z in p(X)−p(z) over ℚ̄ for a polynomial at finite z. For each ψ transcendental over ℚ, each algebraic point x=(P,σ), and each elementary h, the statement asserts the conjunction: h_K(ψ) is transcendental over ℚ; z_x(h_K(ψ)) = h(z_x(ψ)); and e_P(h_K(ψ)) = e_P(ψ) · (e_h(z_x(ψ)) : ℤ). The natural local index is explicitly cast to an integer, so this last equality is an equality and product in ℤ. It is postcomposition of ψ by h: first ψ, then h.     (x : QbarPoint M.K) (h : NoncriticalP1.ElemMap) :

      ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P * (h.ramIdx (noncriticalValue M x ψ) : ℤ) := by
  sorry

Thus M.K is an intermediate field of the algebraic closure of ℚ(t), with elements u and v such that u is transcendental over ℚ, u^N + v^N = 1, ℚ(u,v) = M.K, and M.K is finite of degree N over ℚ(u). Let hDVR assert that every place has a discrete valuation ring. A place P is a proper valuation subring O_P of M.K containing ℚ; no affine restriction is imposed. Write κ(P) for its full residue field and res_P : O_P → κ(P) for the actual residue map. The integer ord_P is the normalized discrete order, with the convention ord_P(0) = 0. For any f ∈ M.K, define the integer e_P(f) as ord_P(q(f)) when f ∈ O_P, where q = minpoly_ℚ(res_P(f)), and as −ord_P(f) when f ∉ O_P. This is the actual definition of ramIdx M hDVR f P. An algebraic point x consists of any such place P and any ring embedding σ : κ(P) → ℚ̄, where ℚ̄ is the fixed algebraic closure of ℚ. Its value z_x(f) is σ(res_P(f)) if f ∈ O_P, and ∞ otherwise. Thus all places, the full residue fields, and every residue-field embedding are retained. An elementary map h is either a rational Möbius map (az+b)/(cz+d), with a,b,c,d ∈ ℚ and ad−bc ≠ 0, or a polynomial p ∈ ℚ[X] of positive natural degree. Its field action h_K uses this rational expression or p(f). On ℙ¹(ℚ̄), a Möbius map sends a finite z with cz+d=0 to ∞ and otherwise to (az+b)/(cz+d); it sends ∞ to ∞ if c=0 and to a/c otherwise. A polynomial sends finite z to p(z) and ∞ to ∞. Its natural-number local index e_h(z) is 1 for a Möbius map, deg(p) for a polynomial at ∞, and the root multiplicity of z in p(X)−p(z) over ℚ̄ for a polynomial at finite z. theorem noncriticalCompositionRamification {N : ℕ} (M : Model N)
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (ψ : M.K) (hψ : Transcendental ℚ ψ) :
    (∀ P : Place M.K, 0 < ramIdx M hDVR ψ P) ∧
    ∀ (hs : List NoncriticalP1.ElemMap) (x : QbarPoint M.K),
      Transcendental ℚ (NoncriticalP1.compK hs ψ) ∧
      noncriticalValue M x (NoncriticalP1.compK hs ψ) =
        NoncriticalP1.evalComp hs (noncriticalValue M x ψ) ∧
      ramIdx M hDVR (NoncriticalP1.compK hs ψ) x.P =
        ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P *
          (NoncriticalP1.ramIdxComp hs (noncriticalValue M x ψ) : ℤ) := by
  refine ⟨noncriticalRamificationPositive M hDVR ψ hψ, ?_⟩
  intro hs x
  induction hs generalizing ψ with
  | nil =>
    exact ⟨hψ, rfl, by simp [NoncriticalP1.compK, NoncriticalP1.ramIdxComp]⟩
  | cons h hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ :=
      noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification M hDVR ψ hψ x h
    obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3⟩ := ih (ψ := NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) h1
    refine ⟨i1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change noncriticalValue M x (NoncriticalP1.compK hs (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ)) = _
      rw [i2, h2]
      rfl
    · change ramIdx M hDVR (NoncriticalP1.compK hs (NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ)) x.P = _
      rw [i3, h3, h2]
      simp only [NoncriticalP1.ramIdxComp, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc]
